[Fix]

🖼️ **Missing parcel image**: Fixed parcel Flows failing with **"Missing token value: package_image"**. In 1.2.11 older trigger images were released too early when several parcels changed, so a Flow could no longer find its image.

[Improvement]

📦 **One image per parcel**: Every parcel now keeps its **own image** for as long as it is in your PostNL account. On every status change it is **redrawn with the current status**, delivery window and progress.

🛟 **Always an image**: If a parcel image cannot be created, the Flow falls back to the **My Delivery** image, so the image token is **never empty**.

🧹 **Automatic clean-up**: Images of parcels that disappear from your PostNL account are released automatically to keep memory usage low.

🌟 Enjoy the improved PostNL v1.2.12 App with reliable parcel images in every Flow.
